scope: Six playback-confirmed CamerasRJ IDs in one Estrada do Tingui address cluster: 7656, 7657, 7658, 7652, 7653, 7648. No full inventory scan was repeated.
method: Reviewed catalog/inventory and audit records, attempted fresh public player capture in one sequential Chrome browser using isolated local iframe wrapper, and inspected every captured screenshot. Successful playback metadata confirms moving streams but was not used as visual evidence. Failed fresh captures remain individually labeled.
comparison: 7656/7657 share exact catalog name/address/coordinates but separate published player IDs. 7656 yielded a roadway image; 7657 did not render a frame in this visual review. Therefore whether they duplicate one physical feed is unresolved. The separately captured 7653 image is a different scene from 7656, but its address differs and it does not answer the 7656/7657 duplicate question. No direction or FOV inferred from playback metadata.
